name: How do outdoor kitchens enhance home value in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: How do outdoor kitchens enhance home value in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: High-quality outdoor kitchens add 7-12% to resale value by creating functional entertaining spaces that appeal to California's indoor-outdoor lifestyle, especially in desirable neighborhoods.
